# Junior Data Scientist

**Smørblomst Mejeri** · Copenhagen (hybrid) · 2 positions

Smørblomst is a dairy cooperative owned by 200 farms. We forecast how much milk, butter
and cheese our customers will order, and we are hiring two junior data scientists to join
our team of four.

## What you will do

- Maintain and improve our weekly demand forecasts.
- Analyse sales, waste and promotions for our planners.
- Learn from experienced colleagues and grow with us.

## What we are looking for

- Python for data analysis.
- Some SQL.
- Some experience with forecasting, from work, a thesis or projects.
- A basic understanding of statistics.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

No years of experience required: this is a junior role.

## Nice to have

- Experience with demand forecasting for food or retail.
- Deep learning, from work or studies.
- Danish.

We offer a mentor, a training budget and cheese on Fridays.
